task.title: intword returns the plain integer for values from 10**36 up to a googol
task.body:
Why: https://github.com/python-humanize/humanize/issues/356 ; src/humanize/number.py intword picks decillion for every value between 10**36 and a googol, so `intword(10**50)` returns '100000000000000000.0 decillion' and `intword(10**99)` returns a 66 digit count.
Outcome: `humanize.intword(value, format="%.1f")` falls back to the plain integer text `str(int(value))` for every integer whose absolute value is at least 10**36 and that does not round to a googol: `intword(10**36) == '1000000000000000000000000000000000000'`, `intword(10**50) == '100000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000'`, `intword(-10**50) == '-100000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000'`, `intword(10**99 - 1)` equals `str(10**99 - 1)`. Unchanged: `intword(999 * 10**33) == '999.0 decillion'`, `intword(10**35) == '100.0 decillion'`, `intword(10**100) == '1.0 googol'`, `intword(10**100 - 10**93) == '1.0 googol'`, `intword(-10**100) == '-1.0 googol'`, `intword(10**101) == '10.0 googol'`.
Proof: add tests to tests/test_number.py.

spec: `humanize.intword(value, format="%.1f")` falls back to the plain integer text `str(int(value))` for every integer whose absolute value is at least 10**36 and that does not round to a googol: `intword(10**36) == '1000000000000000000000000000000000000'`, `intword(10**50) == '100000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000'`, `intword(-10**50) == '-100000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000'`, `intword(10**99 - 1)` equals `str(10**99 - 1)`. Unchanged: `intword(999 * 10**33) == '999.0 decillion'`, `intword(10**35) == '100.0 decillion'`, `intword(10**100) == '1.0 googol'`, `intword(10**100 - 10**93) == '1.0 googol'`, `intword(-10**100) == '-1.0 googol'`, `intword(10**101) == '10.0 googol'`.
install: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/python -m pip install -q babel -e '.[tests]' && .venv/bin/pybabel --quiet compile --directory src/humanize/locale --domain humanize
